Thanks again for agreeing to onboard with Redwood. I'm Monica on the procurement/onboarding side — I'll be coordinating the setup so your finance and ops teams can receive POs. Quick asks:
- Can you confirm the email you're using for the vendor profile (procurement@acme-supplies.com)?
- Please upload the attached W-9 and KYC bundle if you haven't already (I've attached the file names below).
- If there's a portal screenshot of the error from your side, please attach it — helps us diagnose faster.

I opened enrollment ticket #4731 internally and copied Laura (procurement ops). Next steps on our side: we can start a manual provisioning flow if the portal continues to block account creation. That will take ~24–48 hours and requires a signed vendor form (I can send it if you need).

Attachments: W9_Acme_Supplies.pdf (requested), KYC_Acme_Supplies.zip (optional — preferred)

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm contact email + upload/confirm docs (today)
2) If portal still errors, we kick manual provisioning and email you the vendor form (Monica leads)
3) Once profile is active, we'll send a sample PO and do a quick PO reconciliation call (15 min)

Thanks — aiming for vendor onboarding complete by Nov 30 if possible.

Best,
Monica

Monica / Laura — thanks for flagging and for the attachments, Sarah.

Quick answers:
- ERR-IDENT-22 looks like an upstream vendor portal (Coupa) identity verification block. Our integration simply relays the invite — when the portal rejects on identity, it returns that code. We can confirm with our Coupa ops team but it will likely require either (a) retrying registration with a verified email or (b) manual vendor provisioning.

Recommended path: manual provisioning for this account to hit your Monday timeline. For manual provisioning I need the completed vendor form with the following fields filled: legal entity name, DBA, tax id (EIN), remittance address, primary finance contact name/email/phone, payment terms, and banking remittance instruction (if you want ACH set up now, otherwise we can do card/ACH later). If Acme prefers to delay bank info, we can still provision and issue sample POs.

Monica — can you send the vendor form to Sarah (I'll attach a template) and mark the provisioning ticket high priority?

Sarah — if you can return the vendor form today we can provision and schedule a quick PO test. Otherwise, confirm whether procurement@acme-supplies.com can re-register with finance@acme-supplies.com as the primary contact and we can retry the portal flow.

Ben
Ben Carter
